questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Of all five sketches, hers is the ___.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The musician played the difficult passage ___.

guide.explanation: An adverb modifies played; smoothly is the appropriate form.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The soup tastes ___.

guide.explanation: Tastes is a linking verb here; an adjective describes the soup.

questions.stem: Choose the sentence without a dangling modifier.

Walking into the studio, the mural surprised me.
Walking into the studio, the lights were bright.
Walking into the studio, a desk blocked my view.

guide.explanation: The subject I is the person walking. The other subjects cannot logically perform that action.

questions.stem: Choose the sentence with parallel structure.
choices: We enjoy hiking, swimming, and to cycle.
We enjoy hiking, to swim, and cycling.

We enjoy hiking, swimming, and cycling.

guide.explanation: All three objects use matching -ing forms.

questions.stem: Choose the complete sentence.
choices: Although it was raining, the match continued.

guide.explanation: Only the first choice contains an independent clause with a subject and finite verb.

questions.stem: Choose the correct verb: The scissors ___ in the drawer.

guide.explanation: Scissors is grammatically plural in this sentence.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct completion: The student ___ won the contest thanked her teacher.

guide.explanation: Who is the subject of won and refers to a person.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: There were ___ mistakes in the second draft.

guide.explanation: Mistakes are countable, so use fewer.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: We have ___ time than we expected.

guide.explanation: Time is an uncountable quantity here, so use less.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the folder on my desk.

guide.explanation: Lay means put something down and takes folder as its object.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: I need to ___ down for a few minutes.

guide.explanation: Lie means recline and does not take an object; need to takes the base form.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The sun will ___ at dawn.

guide.explanation: Rise is intransitive; raise requires an object.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Please ___ your hand before speaking.

guide.explanation: Raise takes the object your hand.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The new schedule may ___ attendance.

guide.explanation: Affect is the verb meaning influence; may requires the base form.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The change had an immediate ___ on attendance.

guide.explanation: Effect is the noun meaning result, fitting after an immediate.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Everyone ___ Elena arrived before noon.

guide.explanation: Except means excluding. Accept means receive or agree to.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The coach offered useful ___.

guide.explanation: Advice is the noun; advise is a verb.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The counselor will ___ us about course choices.

guide.explanation: Will takes a base-form verb, advise.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: I would rather read ___ watch television.

guide.explanation: Rather ... than makes a comparison; then concerns time.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Finish your outline; ___ write the essay.

guide.explanation: Then indicates the next step in time.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The hikers left ___ boots outside.

guide.explanation: Their shows that the boots belong to the hikers.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: ___ planning a neighborhood cleanup.

guide.explanation: They're expands to they are, which supplies the subject and verb.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The puppy chased ___ tail.

guide.explanation: Its is possessive; it's means it is or it has.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: ___ likely to snow tonight.

guide.explanation: It's expands to it is, producing a complete sentence.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: I do not want to ___ the receipt.

guide.explanation: Lose is the verb meaning misplace; loose means not tight.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The museum is ___ the library and the theater.

guide.explanation: Between identifies a position relative to two named places.
guide.shortcut: Read the complete sentence and identify the convention being tested before comparing choices.

questions.stem: Which revision removes the unclear pronoun? Original: When Lena met Priya, she was holding a violin. The writer means Priya held it.
choices: She held a violin when Lena met Priya.
When Lena met Priya, she held it.
When Lena met Priya, Priya was holding a violin.
Lena met her while she held the violin.

guide.explanation: Repeating Priya makes the intended person explicit; the other versions leave ambiguous pronouns.

questions.stem: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
choices: After, the final bell rang the students left.
After the final bell rang the students, left.
After the final bell rang, the students left.
After the final bell, rang the students left.

guide.explanation: A comma separates an introductory dependent clause from the main clause.

questions.stem: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
choices: I brought, a notebook a ruler and a pencil.
I brought a notebook, a ruler, and a pencil.

guide.explanation: Commas separate the three list items; no comma separates brought from its objects.

questions.stem: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
choices: The bus was late, but we arrived on time.
The bus was late but, we arrived on time.

The bus was late, but, we arrived on time.

choices: The trail was steep, we climbed slowly.

The trail was steep we climbed, slowly.

questions.stem: Which sentence best introduces a paragraph about ways the school garden helps students learn?
choices: The school cafeteria opens at noon.
The school garden serves as an outdoor classroom in several subjects.
Some students prefer winter to summer.

guide.explanation: The correct topic sentence introduces learning benefits broadly; the others are unrelated or too narrow.

questions.stem: Which detail best supports the claim that a library should stay open later?
choices: Students with after-school jobs often cannot arrive before the current closing time.

guide.explanation: The job schedules explain why later hours would improve access.

choices: Finally, apply and press down the patch.

guide.explanation: Color preference does not explain the repair process.
